offering_description.value: Angi connects homeowners with local professionals for home repairs, maintenance and improvements. It runs websites and apps where homeowners can compare providers, request quotes or book jobs, and where service professionals can advertise and buy leads.

primary_services.value: Contractor search and matching; lead generation; contractor advertising; home service booking

customer_segment.value: B2B: Local contractors, tradespeople and home service businesses; B2C: Homeowners and other residents hiring local service professionals

end_markets.value: Home repair and maintenance; residential remodeling; home cleaning; lawn care and landscaping

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Service professionals pay for leads from prospective customers; advertising: Service professionals pay for online visibility and promotion; service fees: Homeowners pay for jobs booked directly through the platform; subscription: Paid memberships for service professionals and consumers
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; advertising; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Matches homeowner project requests with local service professionals; service provider: Arranges booked jobs for homeowners through independent service professionals

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, the United Kingdom and continental Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Contractor listings, paid leads, advertising and direct booking for home services

distribution_channels.value: online: Company websites and mobile apps for homeowners and contractors; direct sales: Sales teams sell advertising and lead programs to service professionals

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Lead sales, advertising and customer data are subject to consumer protection and privacy rules

notes: The exact country footprint and current availability of paid memberships may vary by market.
